en.headline: Museum Festival carnival brings nostalgic Hong Kong scenes to Tsim Sha Tsui this weekend
en.dek: The free Fun at Museum Carnival on October 31 and November 1 at the Cultural Centre Piazza features a pixelated egg tart, a traditional Chinese medicine shop and other installations under the theme of collaging past and present.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 opens this weekend with a free carnival at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The Fun at Museum Carnival, running from 11am to 6pm on Saturday and Sunday, takes the theme “A Collage of Past and Present: Hong Kong Story”. Installations include a recreated street-side tea stall with tables that tell local history, a one-metre-high pixelated egg tart for public sticker art, a traditional Chinese medicine shop where visitors can try dispensing herbs, and a fortune-telling coin-toss booth.
The two-day event is part of a month-long festival running until November 30 that includes more than 60 programmes across LCSD museums. Organisers said the carnival is open to all and free of charge.

zh.headline: 香港博物館節周末嘉年華 尖沙咀重現懷舊香港場景
zh.dek: 10月31日及11月1日文化中心露天廣場免費「繚Fun博物館嘉年華」，設像素蛋殿、傳統中藥舖等裝置，主題為拼貼今昔。
body: 康樂及文化事務署主辦的「香港博物館節2026」本周末以嘉年華揭幕，在尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場免費舉行。
「繚Fun博物館嘉年華」於周六及日上午11時至下午6時舉行，主題為「拼貼今昔，香港故事」。場內設有重塑街坊茶檔、1米高巨型像素蛋殿供市民貼貼紙創作、傳統中藥舖執藥體驗，以及揙銀幣命運盲盒等裝置。
為期兩日的活動是整個11月博物館節的一部分，節期至11月30日，康文署轄下場館將推出逾60項節目。主辦方表示活動免費開放。
